comment: Rejected: (1) CRED_LIC_AUTHORISATIONS should also give the licensee's activity: the reviewed crosswalk anzsic_credit_authorisation maps the whole authorisation text (before splitting) to ANZSIC (credit provider vs credit assistance); add it as ext.entity.industry_code with scheme anzsic2006. (2) The authorisation split emitted ~10 fragments per licence, many of them lead-in headings ('This licence authorises the licensee to:', '... by:'); emit one observation per authorised activity and drop the headings, or keep the publisher's top-level '~' items only. (3) CRED_LIC_LAT / CRED_LIC_LNG are coordinates of the licensee's own address: map them to ext.entity.address_point (geo_point, latitude first) if the values support it. (4) CRED_LIC_STATUS is a code (APPR/SUSP); keep it, but its valid_from should not come from the licence start date unless the publisher dates the status. Keep everything else that passed.
